name: Sweden

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (up to 90 days) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a Schengen visa (age 12+)
fees.notes: Common EU Schengen short-stay visa fee, raised to EUR 90 for adults effective June 2024. Sweden is a full Schengen member and applies the common EU fee schedule; fee is non-refundable if rejected.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 6-11 years
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Half the adult common Schengen fee.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 0-5 years
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - business purpose
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a Schengen visa
fees.notes: Same fee schedule and application type as the tourist Schengen visa; category is set by purpose of travel, not a separate fee tier.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (ATV)
fees.applies: nationals of countries requiring an airport transit visa for Sweden/Schengen
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee applies to airport transit visas as well; exact amount not separately itemised on the source page, recorded at common Schengen rate pending direct confirmation.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (future requirement for visa-exempt travellers)
fees.applies: visa-exempt nationalities once ETIAS is enforced
fees.notes: ETIAS is an EU-wide (not Sweden-specific) pre-travel authorisation for visa-exempt nationals, not yet enforced as of 2026-07-02 per official rollout guidance; fee amount left null pending an official EU/ETIAS launch confirmation. Do not confuse with the Schengen visa fee above. Fee of EUR 20 per person confirmed per the country file's ETIAS forthcoming-systems note (travel-europe.europa.eu/en/etias); persons under 18 and over 70 are exempt.

reciprocity_variations.note: Citizens of countries with an EU Visa Facilitation Agreement (Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Cape Verde, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia, Ukraine) pay a reduced Schengen visa fee; exact reduced amount not published on the Migrationsverket summary page - applicants directed to contact the relevant Swedish embassy/consulate for the specific figure.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Swedish visa application centres in many source countries (including India, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Philippines, and others). Published one-pager quotes a service fee of approx EUR 21 / USD 24.44 in addition to the Migrationsverket visa fee; the exact amount varies by country/centre and is typically charged in local currency at the centre's rate.

free_visa_notes: Sweden is a full Schengen Area member; nationals of many countries (EU/EEA, and a long visa-waiver list including USA, CAN, GBR, NZL, JPN, KOR and others) do not need a visa for short stays up to 90/180 days and pay no fee, though ETIAS authorisation will eventually apply to those visa-exempt travellers once enforced EU-wide.
